تعالمت (form VI)
# تَعَالَمْتُ (taʕālamtu) /ta.ʕaː.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# تَعَالَمْتَ (taʕālamta) /ta.ʕaː.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# تَعَالَمْتِ (taʕālamti) /ta.ʕaː.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# تَعَالَمَتْ (taʕālamat) /ta.ʕaː.la.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
